policy: Only repository-recoverable source facts may define the Question/Canonical/Answer contract. Ambiguity must remain explicit; missing deterministic contracts must be remediated instead of synthesized.

items.boundary: raw source requires one transaction and all optimal intervals; it does not state whether the array stores absolute prices or per-period rises/falls
nondecreasing input, in-place mutation and an example establishing unique nondecreasing prefix followed by nondecreasing duplicate suffix are recovered
file-backed N-number Top-10 request is recovered; number representation, duplicate semantics, malformed-row policy and N<10 behavior are not
Leaky Bucket rate limiting algorithm is explicit; weight, clock, precision, reject/block behavior, concurrency and public API are not
raw note preserves only 股票问题 while structured/current wording widens it to a whole best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock series with no recovered transaction contract
structured/tagged source consistently asks for Java code whose surprising outcome is allowed by instruction reordering; adjacent volatile and happens-before questions establish JMM context
delete the fewest characters from s so p becomes a substring; retained context says the problem is sliding-window-like, implying shortest span containing p as a subsequence
mirror a binary tree with both recursive and non-recursive implementations is recovered; mutation/copy API and empty-tree behavior are not
array plus int target and shortest subarray with sum >= target are recovered; positivity is not stated
odd-position nodes ascending, even-position nodes descending, no cross-order relation, globally sort in O(n) time/O(1) space; source records split-reverse-merge solution direction
